summary: Bigwords.page is a browser extension that overlays large text on any webpage, turning the page into a sign. It works entirely client‑side in the browser and requires no API keys. It is suited for users who want a quick visual emphasis on web content without installing separate software. The main strength is its immediate, zero‑setup installation, while the lack of benchmarks and limited integration options are notable drawbacks.
